## apiome sdk {#sdk}

Generated SDK evidence: what each generated artifact covers and leaves out.

```text
apiome sdk [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`compatibility`](#sdk-compatibility).

## apiome sdk compatibility {#sdk-compatibility}

Show the generator compatibility manifest for a version (GET …/sdk-compatibility).

Findings come first, each with the action that fixes it; then one line per generated artifact (coverage, runtime, unsupported auth, pagination); then semver and the source and options digests. Exit 4 when --fail-on is met.

```text
apiome sdk compatibility [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `--version` | text |  |  | Version label or revision UUID (default: the latest revision). |
| `--fail-on` | text |  |  | Exit 4 when a finding is at or above this severity: error, warning or info. |
